name: dribbble_jobs-mcp
description: Dribbble Jobs (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Dribbble Jobs RSS 2.0 feed (all current design jobs, ~50). keyword is the job board's search parameter carried into the feed (checked 2026-09-25: ?keyword=brand narrows the feed, a nonsense keyword returns an empty channel); location, page and limit are not sent (the feed is one list; ignore next_page). title is '<Company> is hiring for a position of <Role> in <Location>'; company is the dc:creator. id is the posting link.
